propositions: GitHub Actions workflow UI lists workflows by name: field, but several workflows have lowercase non-descriptive name values making the Actions tab hard to scan and inconsistent.
Workflow files use inconsistent naming conventions: some use .yaml extension instead of .yml standard, and some have filename/name mismatches (e.g., eval.yml with name: prompt-eval).
eval-plan-review-container.yml is closed scaffolding for story da34 and should be deleted with its references removed.

Workflow name: fields must be rewritten to descriptive Title Case per a locked reference table, and files must be renamed to lowercase-with-hyphens convention; gerrit-verify.yaml and release.yml are exceptions that retain their filenames.
All in-repo references to renamed workflows (eval.yml → prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yaml → verify-identity.yml) must be updated across documentation and test files.
Workflow naming conventions must pass linting (actionlint) and existing workflow-pinning tests, with a new test (test_workflow_names.py) pinning names and extensions.
